# Mission backdrops

These are official VALORANT map splash artworks distributed by
[Valorant-API](https://valorant-api.com/v1/maps). The source URLs were verified
against the API metadata on 2026-10-22.

| Asset | Map | Source |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ascent.jpg` | Ascent | https://media.valorant-api.com/maps/7eaecc1b-4337-bbf6-6ab9-04b8f06b3319/splash.png |
| `haven.jpg` | Haven | https://media.valorant-api.com/maps/2bee0dc9-4ffe-519b-1cbd-7fbe763a6047/splash.png |
| `lotus.jpg` | Lotus | https://media.valorant-api.com/maps/2fe4ed3a-450a-948b-6d6b-e89a78e680a9/splash.png |
| `sunset.jpg` | Sunset | https://media.valorant-api.com/maps/92584fbe-486a-b1b2-9faa-39b0f486b498/splash.png |

Downloaded on 2026-10-22 and converted to optimized progressive JPEGs at
1920×1080. Haven, Lotus, and Sunset use JPEG quality 84; Lotus was resized from
3840×2160 with Lanczos resampling. Ascent is the existing asset.

Artwork belongs to Riot Games. Its use follows the same hackathon authorization
documented for the project's existing official map assets.
